name: Slider
description: Numeric input with ordered thumbs and an optional independently editable crop interval.

value.description: Controlled value: a number, or one number per thumb; callbacks answer in the same shape. Shown snapped, clamped and sorted.

defaultValue.description: Value on mount, restored by form reset; a number or an array, as for value. Defaults to min.

label.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

description.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

error.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Dynamic errors are mirrored to a polite live region.

labelPosition.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

min.description: Lower end of the scale and origin of the step grid; crossed or non-finite bounds use 0..100. Defaults to 0.

max.description: Upper end of the scale; crossed or non-finite bounds use 0..100. Defaults to 100.

step.description: Distance between selectable values; End selects the last step at or below max. Defaults to 1.

disabled.description: Blocks editing, crop included, and leaves every control out of FormData.

orientation.description: Horizontal follows the text direction; vertical increases upward. Defaults to horizontal.

aria-label.description: Names the group and its thumbs when there is no visible label.

aria-labelledby.description: Ids of elements that name the group and its thumbs; they take precedence over label and aria-label.

labels.description: Complete accessible names for individual thumbs and crop boundaries.

showValue.description: Shows each primary value inside its thumb.

crop.description: Adds two crop boundaries on a second rail, edited independently of the value.

cropRange.description: Controlled crop boundaries; undefined leaves them uncontrolled.

defaultCropRange.description: Crop boundaries on mount, restored by form reset. Defaults to the whole scale.

clampToCrop.description: Keeps the shown value inside the crop boundaries. Defaults to true.

name.description: FormData key of the value, repeated once per thumb in ascending order.

cropName.description: FormData key of the crop boundaries, repeated for start and end while crop is on.

form.description: Id of the form that submits and resets the controls, when it is not an ancestor.

required.description: Shows the required marker on the label; a range always has a value, so it never blocks submission.

autoFocus.description: Focuses the first thumb on mount.

membrane.description: Shared outer spacing around each thumb; toggling it keeps the DOM and focus. Defaults to true.

notes: Each thumb is a native range input with its own accessible name, bounds and orientation.
Use label, aria-label or aria-labelledby for the group; labels provides complete individual names.
formatValue supplies accessible value text, including units.
One native input lives inside every thumb and enabled crop part. Membrane surrounds each control without adding tab stops.
Measured control extents reserve track edges; all handles share logical track coordinates.
Hit areas remain at least 24px even when control density is smaller.
Private Slider variables describe geometry, not alternate behavior.

whenNotToUse: Few discrete options (use Radio or Select)
